import asyncio,json,uuid,dataclasses,hashlib
import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select,text
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models.fbs_order import FbsOrder
from app.models.fbs_supply import FbsSupply
from app.services.fbs_print_asset_service import request_supply_print_batch
from app.services.fbs_print_asset_storage import read_print_file
from app.services.fbs_workspace_service import get_supply_workspace
TENANT=uuid.UUID("5baaf211-7cb7-495d-9c2b-b42121606bf9")
SUPPLY=uuid.UUID("e40f5495-4f1f-5e7d-ba0c-035665fde995")
SELLER=uuid.UUID("c52ef05d-f787-4de5-acc5-76f9736691aa")
IDS={uuid.UUID(x) for x in ["1f1febff-2ad0-47a8-a3b5-a2bd237f4e43","959f0737-f301-47b9-bb56-74cc77f17120","9d87bd87-6e72-47a1-99f5-0359e3c0d77b"]}
async def main():
 async with SessionLocal() as s:
  supply=await s.get(FbsSupply,SUPPLY)
  assert supply and supply.tenant_id==TENANT and supply.seller_id==SELLER and supply.marketplace=="ozon"
  rows=list(await s.scalars(select(FbsOrder).where(FbsOrder.supply_id==SUPPLY)))
  assert {o.id for o in rows}==IDS
  async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
   result=await request_supply_print_batch(s,TENANT,SUPPLY,kind="order_sticker",order_ids=sorted(IDS),retry_missing=True,http_client=client)
  record={"requested":result.requested,"ready":result.ready,"missing":result.missing,"failed":result.failed,"errors":[dataclasses.asdict(e) for e in result.order_errors],"assets":[{"id":str(a.id),"order_id":str(a.fbs_order_id),"content_type":a.content_type,"storage_path":a.storage_path,"checksum":a.checksum,"status":a.status} for a in result.assets]}
  await s.commit()
  print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,default=str))
asyncio.run(main())
